answer: An identity claims a delta distributary, locks 70 credits and files a flow survey in the ocean ledger. An auditor remeasures it on the delta table; a reused survey or broken total burns the bond; an oasis stamp key-bound to the filer blocks a rented-survey ring. First survey 32; k-th on one funding key pays 32+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,029,000 plus 70,000 in bonds for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 32 once, bond back after one clean epoch.
